source_text: Observavimus differentiam: in quibusdam plagis induratur cor, in aliis Dominus indurat. Ubi magi cessant et ulcera urgent, terribilius additur. Ordo iudicii paulatim crescit.
pass_a_gloss: We-have-observed difference: in certain plagues is-hardened heart, in others Lord hardens. Where magicians cease and ulcers press, more-terribly is-added. Order of-judgment little-by-little grows.
pass_b_english: We noted another difference: in earlier strokes the heart “is hardened”; when ulcers break the magicians’ stand, Scripture speaks more terribly — [[the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart >> Bible:Exodus 9:12]]. Judgment escalates as resistance deepens.
